mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right roofing material during a consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: During your consultation, our specialists will discuss various roofing materials suited for the DFW climate, such as asphalt shingles, metal roofing, or TPO. The right choice depends on factors like your budget, desired aesthetics, durability requirements, and energy efficiency goals. For example, asphalt shingles are cost-effective, while metal roofs offer long-term durability and energy savings. We'll help you weigh the pros and cons of each option.
